title: How many recalled vehicles were actually repaired
what: One row per campaign in the authority's annual completion-rate list: vehicles recalled, and the share repaired by the eighth quarterly report. Every row is cross-checked against the bulk file and any that disagrees is excluded and counted.
source: NHTSA annual list of recall completion rates, read from the PDF itself
